# Metal: Hellsinger AP World v1.1.2 Hotfix for both the AP World _and_ the client. **NOTE:** The client may not correctly display available locations for seeds generated on 1.1.0 and 1.1.1, but is compatible with seeds generated on those.
- [Metal: Hellsinger AP World](https://github.com/DanielSchaack/ArchipelagoMetalHellsinger/releases/latest) - [Metal: Hellsinger Randomizer Mod](https://github.com/DanielSchaack/Metal-Hellsinger-AP-Mod/releases/latest) - [Setup Guide](https://github.com/DanielSchaack/ArchipelagoMetalHellsinger/blob/main/worlds/metal_hellsinger/docs/setup_en.md)

entry.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong v0.4.5r2
entry.content:
Oops, so much for "one week break" but I felt very guilty over the state of 0.4.4 so I cut it a bit shorter. This is (despite the amount) a relatively half-baked update since not much was done for logic. The mappers are still working and I only have so much time to commit for it, especially with an event starting up in 11 hours. (Also obligatory this is for fun/free but if you wanna [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) I'd smile)
# Changelog
**General** - **Greatly overhauled Abyss story progression** - Lace Tower and Unravelled Silk Heart memories are skipped - There's also an additional YAML option to have faster (seamless) Silkheart pickup, defaulting to off - Needle upgrades and Pale Oils now have independent vanilla / anywhere options - Mottled Skarr: Curveclaw and Fractured Mask now remain collectible as AP checks after the merchant dies. Receiving either tool elsewhere no longer hides its unchecked location - Fixed Naked Trap persisting during deaths, memory fights, saves and resets - Reconnects now serialize connection attempts, discard stale-session callbacks and detach old callbacks - Save rollback now restores received items (it already did before but not as thoroughly as it should've) - Fixed reconnects unnecessary save hitch - Removed Hunter’s March - Rosary Chest and Far Fields - Rosary Chest 2 - get_logical_path & explain properly work with UT now (sorry :D) - Grand Mother Silks title card included in alphabet mode - Starting-crest slots remain in the pool even when that crest’s vanilla source is beyond the selected act goal - Fixed infinite jump/wall-slide exploit without Cling Grip - Cursed Crest bench restoration now refreshes both the spool and crest HUD, but never interferes with the real story curse - Alphabet/Spelling Bee generation now checks placement capacity and fails clearly instead of producing impossible fills - Vog hints now use Cogwork Core, High Halls, Memorium or Whispering Vaults instead of the vague Outlying Citadel label - Closed the abortion clinic on cursed ending wincon (no more self-softlocking allowed) - Inventory looked fucky while naked trap is happening - Bone Bottom/restored Bellhart: the title card no longer blocks benches or NPC interaction - Beastling Call disabled during Act 3 intro - No sending deathlink for dying during memory fights - Earlier Silkheart on ability rando to lessen reports over players not knowing that Needolin / Silksoar / Clawline require silk and also to put soar/line into logic earlier since not having silk could lead to softlocks - No more free dashing during specific frames when only owning one half of split swift step (by Skai) - Flea Brew refreshes by sitting on benches (by Skai) - Multibinder purchase mistakenly excluded from Act 1 - Fixed several things being in act 1/act 2/cursed ending when they shouldn't - After Widow defeat incoming DeathLinks now remain queued until Widow’s shrine completion finishes, then activate somewhere safe - Bilewater East Memory Locket now identifies the moving hanging-sack pickup by its exact hierarchy - Crest-slot hints now refresh immediately when scouting finishes instead of appearing blank on the first hover - F4 and recovery warps are blocked while Abyss Escape is active, preventing the escape sequence from being skipped and story progression from desynchronizing - Fixed Trobbio’s regular and Tormented Claw Mirror checks not triggering from the proper victory reward states - Objective Open: Grand Gate properly shows AP-owned bell amount and which ones - Bells from bellshrine-sanity cannot be put into Act 3 (sorry I forgot the fleas need to pass through Judge arena) - Receiving the Curvesickle upgrade while Curveclaw is equipped now updates the tool immediately instead of temporarily disabling it until a room change - Grouped together Far Fields Shell Shard Caches 2-3 and Rosary Cache 18 as one map marker, same with Shell Shard Cache 4-5 - The Blasted Steps entrance sign from Shellwood and the Terminus Commandment are now randomized lore locations - The nonexistent Memorium Bone Plaque and Clover Plaque locations have been removed - Better Bell/Melody tracking if the YAML option to show them on map is on - Shakra doesn't leave (no need for additional mods) in fact uninstall ShakraAlwaysOnSite, that mod messed with flags (bad) - Loose Beast Shard checks dropped by enemies are restored after death or a room reload if they weren’t collected - Alchemist’s Assistant now removes the consumed Needle Phial - Silk and Soul now recognizes an AP-owned Snare Setter - Balm for the Wounded should now suppress the original animation and hand over checks no problem - The second Progressive Claw Mirror properly replaces the first across every crest instead of allowing both mirrors to be equipped - Drifter’s Cloak now works after Faydown with only one Progressive Swift Step, the physical Cloak pickup is no longer needed - Open Grand Gate now appears whenever Act 2 begins, regardless of how the player enters Act 2 - Wreath of Purity now spends one of its three charges when blocking a Muckmaggot trap. Once exhausted, the trap applies normally - Did I ever even mention that Wreath of Purity can block these traps since 0.4.0 ? Pretty nifty right ? - F4/recovery warps now fail active courier deliveries through the game’s delivery-breaking behavior - Collecting the randomized Shellwood Mask Shard didn't fire its original event, causing the intended Phacia ambush to not spawn - Opened Silkeaters will respawn if player leaves the room or dies without picking it up and only disappear once they're obtained - Locations sent via /send_location will now disappear as map marker immediately rather than on reboot - item_link had a funky interaction if only one player had alphabet mode on
**Logic** * **Added most of Bilewater in logic** * **Overhauled Putrified Ducts logic** * Left side Greymoor is still (officially) unmapped but it got some temporary logic to hopefully help the worse parts of it that players can get stuck on * Blasted Steps Bellway no longer places Sister Splinter in No Skips logic. Its enemy-pogo route requires Easy Skips * Forge Daughter’s four checks are mapped and no longer LogicUnknown * Only Shellwood - Weaver Harp Inscription requires Needolin in Shellwood_10, not the Pollip Heart or Cling Grip in that map part * First Sinner’s logical path now clearly says to collect the fixed vanilla Heretic Key * Silkshot (Original) reconciles an AP-received Ruined Tool at the repair desk * Restored Queen’s Egg progression logic using Bellhart, Missing Brother, courier delivery and the precise Styx-room * Fixed Rite of Rebirth and follow up quest logic * Fixed Silk and Soul wish being bugged (still needs a major rework though) * Shellwood Mask Shard: removed the "ledge grab alone" route. Sprint alone no longer reaches it due to player expectations * Architect's Melody no longer in logic from just Clawline * Huge Flea can no longer hold required progression until its exact movement requirement is known * Last Judge and everything beyond the arena now require the exact arena-completion event, rather than becoming available from Blasted Steps Bellway access alone * Logic now accounts for Grand Bellway as way to enter citadel/act 2 proper (act 1 goals excluded) * Pimpillo can no longer hold required progression while left-side Greymoor remains unmapped * Far Fields Shell Shard Cache 8 is restricted to filler/useful items because it can become permanently inaccessible * Far Fields Rosary Caches 3 and 4 now correctly require Drifter’s Cloak and Cling Grip (or Scuttlebrace if that option is enabled) * The Skull Cave Mask Shard and shard cache no longer appear in logic without Cling Grip (or Scuttlebrace if that option is enabled) * Entering the Deep Docks mines from Far Fields with Clawline, Silk Soar and one Silk Heart now correctly puts Flintslate, Shard Bundle 1, Forebrothers and the areas beyond them in logic * Broodfeast now recognizes the appropriate AP-owned tools for all three organ types * Greymoor’s Silkeater is now LogicUnknown until western Greymoor is mapped * Great Taste of Pharloom and its Pale Oil reward now require the Last Judge to be defeated (edit: I never considered that the Phantom route is even a possibility. I am part of the problem) * Adjusted Memorium Spool Fragment and Deep Docks Flea (Mines) logic adjusted to need Cling Grip (or Scuttlebrace if that setting is enabled) * Cogwork Core - Pristine Core now has proper Act 3 requirement for logic

entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1r3
entry.content:
Thanks to Konzera taking the plunge to run this in an actual multiworld, I've fixed a couple of important bugs. You need both the new APWorld and mod for these changes. Check the previous release for more details on Wondersanity and other big changes from 0.2.
### Changelog: - Changed some backend behavior so large lists of items are actually sent to the game. - Fixed a typo preventing the Mausoleum of Maussollos check from being sent
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain. 2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 3. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 4. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel).
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet.
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/

entry.title: Taylor Swift Discography v1.2.1
entry.content:

entry.title: Slay the Spire II v1.1.0
entry.content:
Yes you will need a new APworld but your yaml only needs to change by one line from 1.0.1
## Multiplayer Stuff - Testing was done on beta branch so please use that. I did ZERO testing on the main branch for this. - Universal Buffs don't work, this is normal - they're automatically turned into 5 gold. - If you want to use the website to generate the yaml you sort of can: but you need to add a line for "player_count: 1", value can be 1-4. - You can either make one yaml for each player with "player_count: 1" aka one slot per player and each person joins their own slot. Host determines what ascensions and ascension downs count. Everything else should be player dependent - Alternatively: you can set "player_count: 2" or "player_count: 3" or "player_count: 4" in your yaml and everyone connects to the same slot. THEN in game (before you connect to a slot): you can hit Archipelago Settings -> Multiplayer settings and change your player number - Yes the above system can make you generate a big yaml with like 1000+ checks if you wanted to and you can play that in singleplayer. - There's too many multiplayer adjustments / design decisions that had to be done to get this working so just message in the discord channel if you're curious about something, thanks. Also if you need help setting up just ask. - Everyone needs the Archipelago mod installed, yes. Everyone must have the same mod list (if you've installed other mods like say character mods and discover a bug: your bugs will take less priority, try to only run RitsuLib and this Mod (and maybe BaseLib and modded characters but modded characters are also borked) - If you encounter a state divergence: just host again and try again. If this happens frequently: open the dev console with ` or shift+8 and type "ap report" and then send the zipfile (in discord) that it hopefully opens. state divergences are impossible to debug without this so without it: state divergences occur way way before it actually puts the message in game. - Manually Installing the Mod from GitHub Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. Download the "Archipelago.zip" from Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") If a folder called mods does not exist, create it Unzip the contents of Archipelago.zip into mods If you've done this step correctly, your directory structure should look like this: /<slay-the-spire-2-local-files>/mods/Archipelago/ and the contents of that folder should be a bunch of .dll files and a .pck file (there may be more files too, please don't touch anything in this folder)
## Random Bug Fixes - Have 2 saves in multiplayer: recent natural AP checkpoint (ie chests and bosses) and one checkpoint at each floor (probably a temporary adjustment while bugs and state divergences are common so you lose less progress). - Allow disconnecting and connecting to different multiworlds without restarting your game. - Allow golden compass to appear in start of act mode in act 2. - Many many many other bug fixes such as campfire softlock - Controller Support but only for beta branch - Massively overhauled architecture and restructuring of how Beta-Main compatibility works so things might break. - Fix !collect support - Fix progressive ancients, smiths and rests not being cleared in singleplayer leading to more than expected. - Option descriptions should be improved / better - Add accessibility and progression balancing in the yaml template and options creator (note website isn't updated until this stuff becomes a non experimental thing) - Ascension when launching should be more accurate - Shop Checks page button should be more noticeable (looks ugly though) - Shops send out hints automatically - Maybe fix the checks sending between different multiworlds - Remove lasting candy because its too complicated to support properly - Fix bug with visual display of 'Press Start location' being wrong in the Character Tracker UI - Golden Compass is now available in start of act mode in act 2.

entry.title: The Messenger v0.16.0
entry.content:
# Messenger Randomizer AP
Beta release for Messenger AP with many, many not yet merged changes.
## Mod Changelog since v0.15.2 - Add 4 new locations for the generators in Elemental Skylands (disabled by default) alwaysintreble#23 - Support for deferred entrances in UT alwaysintreble#24 - Improve region tracking for UT and poptracker alwaysintreble#30 - Fix some location names that were different from the Apworld alwaysintreble#29 - Improve logging even more
### New since v0.16.0-beta - Fix connection overlay sometimes not showing up, or not showing when disconnected alwaysintreble#32 - Necro cutscene no longer triggers automatically; you need to grab him - Play a portal animation when entering a boss room from the wrong dimension - Add a dimension portal in *Autumn Hills right* instead of automatically switching - Rework the Lost Woods solve to be only temporarily in transition rando when arriving in *Howling Grotto bottom* - Rewrite transition rando to have only one loading instead of two
## Apworld Changelog official release (no change since v0.16.0-beta) - Add 4 new locations for the generators in Elemental Skylands (disabled by default) ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6252 - Fix UT not working with some options ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6132 ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6340 - Add map integration and glitch logic to UT (requires poptracker pack) ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6030 - Add deferred entrances in UT map integration to prevent transition shuffle spoilers - Support for UT explain command ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6278 - Fix transition plando not working for some entrances ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6327 - Many logic fixes ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6124 ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6194 ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6258 ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago#6337
[Commit link](https://github.com/Jouramie/Archipelago/releases/tag/messenger%2F0.16.0-beta)
# Installation Instructions (for Windows, but likely compatible with other systems) Mod installation steps are the same as usual.
## Apworld - Install Archipelago (link below) with the generator enabled. - Place the new `messenger.apworld` file in your custom world folder. - Remove the old `messenger.apworld` file from your `lib/worlds` folder. - When connecting to a _The Messenger_ seed with UT, you will be prompted to locate a The Messenger Track Pack (downloadable [here](https://github.com/alwaysintreble/TheMessengerTrackPack/releases)). **Do not unzip it.** Link the zipped file. Dismiss the prompt if you do not wish to use the map. If needed, you can change the location in your `host.yaml` in your Archipelago installation.
## How to play the new content From the AP Launcher, you can use Options Creator to create a yaml for the beta apworld. That's where you can enable the Elemental Skylands generators shuffle. Once you have your yaml, generate locally.
## Compatibility This release is fully compatible with worlds generated with the official apworld or on the site. Be aware, however, that if you use the tracker from this release, it might show some locations in logic that were not meant to be when the game was generated. Following what's "in logic" in the tracker will not match the spheres server-side.
# Troubleshooting - Make sure you removed your `messenger.apworld` from `lib/worlds` and added the new apworld in `custom_worlds`. - *I can't see the map in UT, even though I linked the track pack.* Make sure you linked **the zipped** track pack. It needs to be zipped. You can change the file by editing your `host.yaml`. - *UT says the local datapackage for the connected game does not match the server's datapackage. Should I be worried?* No. You are connected to a game generated with a previous version of the apworld, but this should not prevent the tracker from working. - Report any issue in the [_#messenger_](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1090822939697500243) channel in the Archipelago Discord. Make sure to ping @jouramie otherwise I won't read.
# Known issues - Loading a saved game in Howling Grotto bottom when transition shuffle is enabled might not solve lost woods correctly. - Going back and forth through the transition in *Howling Grotto bottom* should solve the issue. - When loading a save, if connection cannot be established right away and transition shuffle is enabled, the new *Autumn Hills portal* might be missing. Happens when the room is asleept. - Leaving and reloading the save should fix the issue. - When loading a save right after updating the mod, Lost Woods might unsolve, even if it was before. - Just solve it again.
# We Need Your Help! If you'd like to help integrate this into the main Archipelago releases, drop a comment on one of the pull requests! :wink: Also, please mention in the [_#messenger_](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1090822939697500243) channel that you used it, and report any issues. This will help with the integration process if some players mention using the beta world!

BEFORE MODDING, PLEASE INSTALL AND RUN KHBBS AT LEAST ONCE.
1. Install OpenKH and the Lua Backend. - Download the latest release of OpenKH here: https://github.com/OpenKH/OpenKh/releases/tag/latest - Extract the files to a directory of your choosing. - Open OpenKh.Tools.ModsManager.exe and run first time set up. - When prompted for game edition, choose PC, choose which platform you are playing on (Steam or EGS), navigate to your KH I.5 + II.5 installation folder in the path box, then click "Next" - When prompted, install Panacea, then click "Next" - When prompted, check KHBBS plus any other AP game you play (KH2) and click "Install and configure Lua backend", then click "Next". - Extracting game data for KHBBS is unnecessary, but you may want to extract data for KH2 if you plan on playing KH2 AP. - Click "Finish"
2. Open "OpenKh.Tools.ModsManager.exe" 3. Click the drop down menu at the top-right and choose "Birth by Sleep" 4. Click Mods>Install a New Mod 5. In "Add a new mod from GitHub" paste "gaithern/KH-BBS-AP-LUA" 6. Click Install 7. Navigate to Mod Loader and click "Build Only" 8. Place your khbbs.apworld file in your worlds folder (usually /lib/worlds/) 9. Run ArchipelagoLauncher.exe 10. Click "Generate Template Settings". This will open file explorer 11. Find "Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep.yaml" and copy it to /Players/ (create this folder if it does not exist) 12. Open the YAML file and change the line that says "name: Player{number}" to your desired player name. 13. Adjust the settings in the YAML to your liking 14. Run ArchipelagoGenerate.exe 15. Take the newly created AP_XXX.zip file in /output/ in upload it here: https://archipelago.gg/uploads 16. Open ArchipelagoLauncher.exe 17. Click "KHBBS Client" and connect to your server hosted on archipelago.gg 18. From the zip file mentioned above, retrieve the seed zip file (example: AP-95162914732603780136-P1-Player1_0.5.0.zip) 19. In OpenKH, click the green plus to add a mod, then click "Select and install Mod Archive or Lua Script" 20. Navigate to and select your seed zip. 21. With both the companion and the seed checked, click "Mod Loader", then "Build and Run" 22. Play!
----------
### How the randomizer works:
- All chests, stickers, bonus rewards, and pop up story rewards are randomized. - You must collect 3 Wayfinders to open The Keyblade Graveyard and complete your seed.

entry.title: Taskipelago v1.0.2
entry.content:
Quick bug fix patch
## Bug fixes * Fixed an issue where the offsets for item rows under a filler block were not being offset properly on export * Fixed pop-up windows on linux * Fixed a bug with drawer rendering on linux Note on linux fixes: I use wayland, need verification from other compositor/window manager users
## Known Issues * Universal Tracker is unhappy with the structure of the datapackage because of the dynamic nature of Taskipelago's location names. This is aimed to be resolved in a future patch. This is an issue specifically with multiple taskipelago worlds in a single multiworld with shared item or location names.

entry.title: Brave Fencer Musashi v0.8.1
entry.content:
0.8.1 added: -fixed BP getting reset when reconnecting client when BP Sanity is False
0.8.0 Added: -full map tracker -fixed bell logic (again) -added commands --/teleport [id] ---uses the debug menu to teleport the player to selected area (leave blank to teleport back to town) ---unstable and may crash if used --/export_geometry ---exports the static geometry of the currently loaded level (if no folder was previously selected it will prompt and then run command again), creates an .obj, .mtl, and .png --/export_all_geometry ---teleports player to next area that has yet to have an obj file exported and attempts to export until all are done ---unstable, but it remembers progress so keep running command if disconnected/timeout or restarting emulator if it crashes
Note: -Must use Archipelago v0.6.7 or newer -Not compatible with XDelta Patches, must run unmodified game -compatible with v0.7.1 generations -map tracker with Universal Tracker https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases/tag/Tracker_v0.3.3 -setup guide:https://github.com/AegeusEvander/Brave-Fencer-Musashi-AP-World/blob/main/docs/setup_en.md -Follow development and report bugs on the Archipelago gg Discord, -> Future-game-design -> Brave Fencer Musashi
